subject.title: iOS 15.4.1 - Control UI fails to load with 'Control UI did not start'

question: Should Control UI officially support iOS 15.4.1/WKWebView behind a proxy that rewrites module assets to `text/plain`, or should OpenClaw document a modern-browser plus correct module-MIME requirement?
rationale: Current main handles restart and stale-asset recovery, but old-iOS support or a legacy build would add compatibility surface without a clearly documented support contract or live reproduction.

options.title: Document the support contract first
options.body: Keep the current recovery fallback, document minimum browser/module-MIME requirements, and only sponsor iOS 15 work if live proof shows a valuable supported path.

options.title: Sponsor iOS 15 compatibility
options.body: Add the smallest polyfill/build-target/legacy fallback that makes the Control UI load on iOS 15.4.1 and require live Safari/WKWebView proof before closing.

options.title: Close as unsupported after docs
options.body: If maintainers decide old iOS plus MIME-rewriting proxies are out of scope, close after publishing the minimum support and proxy requirements.

recommendation.title: Document the support contract first
recommendation.body: Keep the current recovery fallback, document minimum browser/module-MIME requirements, and only sponsor iOS 15 work if live proof shows a valuable supported path.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest available owner signal for the Control UI/Gateway boundary and the recent fallback recovery refresh.
